title: MAT Agent Definition — bundle manifest
description: Machine-readable index for MAT-17. Defines the schema for agent definition frontmatter.
notes: Agent definitions are Markdown files with YAML frontmatter in the agents/ directory.
Frontmatter defines identity, capabilities, and constraints; body is the system prompt.
allowed_mat_ops must reference valid MAT-2 operations from codex-code-exec manifest.
cli must reference a valid tool from MAT-16 provider-config schema.
v1.1: Variants extend base agents via variant_of field; specialization enables Crew/Swarm routing.
v1.1: Variants live in agents/variants/ and inherit role from base; cannot override role.
